model.name: ConsistencyGuard.assertNonVacuous
model.description: assertNonVacuous / consistency:strict: composes the S37 guards into ONE ci:gate (pin R-C1 resolver==committed pin + dual-status R-C5 assertStatusConsistent + board-drift R-C2 missing-file=FAIL + migration-refuse R-C7 proveComplete), each guarded by refuseIfVacuous at entry; ANY refusal fails the build (INV-C3-4); folded into ci:gates:raw. Backs the vacuous-BITE suite + the meta-BITE (a stub guard that silent-passes vacuous input turns the suite RED). INV-C3-4/5. R-C3.
